# @salla.sa/analytics

Unified source of truth for Salla's client-side analytics (Jitsu): the tracking
engine, event transformers, and custom-tracker registry used by both the
storefront (twilight) and checkout.

## Entry points

| Import | Contents |
|---|---|
| `@salla.sa/analytics/storefront` | Storefront `Analytics` engine + ~29 storefront event transformers. Talks to the global `Salla` SDK object (config, storage, event bus) — it must run inside a twilight storefront context. |
| `@salla.sa/analytics/checkout` | Checkout `Analytics` engine + checkout/payment event transformers. Reads the server-rendered `window.initialData` payload. Also exports `SessionService`, `initialData`, `sanitizeErrorMessage`, `sanitizeFieldErrors`. |
| `@salla.sa/analytics` | Both engines plus the shared helpers (`resolveAnalyticsHost`, `captureSallaCookies`, tracker registry, `generateSessionId`). |

## Usage

Storefront (twilight SDK — already wired in `@salla.sa/twilight`):

```js
import Analytics from '@salla.sa/analytics/storefront';
Salla.analytics = new Analytics;
```

Checkout:

```js
import Analytics from '@salla.sa/analytics/checkout';
window.analytics = new Analytics;
```

## Shared behavior

- **Session id**: both engines persist `s-session-id_<storeId>` in localStorage
  with a sliding 30-minute TTL, so a customer keeps one tracking session across
  storefront and checkout on the same origin.
- **Host resolution**: `resolveAnalyticsHost` routes events through the store's
  own domain (`<store-origin>/_app/e`), handling salla.sa store paths, demostore
  and custom domains, falling back to `https://salla.cloud/_app/e`.
- **Custom trackers**: `registerTracker({name, track, page})` replays history to
  late-registered trackers and isolates tracker failures.

## Tests

The engines and transformers are covered by the `@salla.sa/twilight` jest suite
(`packages/twilight/tests/analytics`), which boots the full SDK harness the
storefront engine expects.
